evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically through growth (3.08→3.38 Torr, k=20..25) while Ar flow is steady at ~100 sccm and T is at setpoint
MFC steady 99.6-100.4 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow change
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (sensor not installed) or a pump-down/flow-step test: with flow briefly cut, a continued high/rising pressure indicates a leak while a fast decay indicates downstream restriction.
